1.consolidated_definition: mil. Ejercicios básicos de entrenamiento militar. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Porque en basic training tu Drill Seargent puertorriqueño quiere que seas mejor que los gringos y los negros juntos, nunca sacandote la bota de encima. Y cuando terminas te da la mano como si fuera tu pana (Hobbies Puerto Rico.com, 16-08-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Basic training exercises. Raw anglicism, common. Because in basic training your Puerto Rican drill sergeant wants you to be better than the gringos and blacks combined, never letting up on you. And when you finish, he gives you a handshake as if you were his buddy (Hobbies Puerto Rico.com, 16-08-07)
